text.zh_cn:
一颗晶莹的石头，比任何话语都沉重。
- [item:minecraft:diamond] 只生成于 y=16 以下
- 钻石镐可开采 [block:minecraft:obsidian]
- 附魔 [item:minecraft:enchanting_table] 前，先备好钻石
> 别在它面前炫耀财富。
text.en_us:
A glittering stone, heavier than any words.
- [item:minecraft:diamond] only generates below y=16
- A diamond pickaxe mines [block:minecraft:obsidian]
- Save diamonds before enchanting at [item:minecraft:enchanting_table]
> Do not flaunt riches before it.
